title: Sort by Two Rules (Comparator)
statementMd:
`Comparable` gives a class one natural order. A **Comparator** is an order written *outside* the class, so you can sort the same data in different ways.

Sort the words by **length (shortest first)**, and words of equal length **alphabetically**.

**Input**
Line 1: `n`. Line 2: n words.

**Output**
The words in order, one per line.

Build the rule with `Comparator.comparing(...)` and `thenComparing(...)`.
hints: words.sort(comparator) sorts the list in place.
